title: Mongo: scale-out add (rs.add)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add mongo --role secondary`: discovers a provisioned-but-unjoined reachable mongo node and rs.add()s it as a SECONDARY (apply-on-demand, ADR-0010).

observe.what: added <node>:27017 to nexus-rs as a SECONDARY (initial-sync follows)
member count increased; new node syncing then alive

whatProves: MongoAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync joins a provisioned-but-unjoined node via rs.add() routed to the PRIMARY (apply-on-demand; no hand-rolled clone).
